description: A PostHog LLM analytics provider key: an LLM provider API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, ...) that PostHog uses to run LLM-judge evaluations and other LLM analytics features in a project. The key itself is write-only; PostHog only returns a masked form.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the provider key belongs to.

Provider.description: LLM provider the key is for. Changing it replaces the key.

ApiKey.description: The provider API key. Write-only: PostHog never returns it (see ApiKeyMasked). Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:secretsmanager:openai-api-key}}; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: Public HTTPS base URL of an OpenAI-compatible or System One API. For System One, end before /systemone.

SystemOneModel.description: Model ID served by the System One endpoint.

AzureEndpoint.description: Azure OpenAI endpoint URL. For an Anthropic key served by Microsoft Foundry, the endpoint of the Foundry resource, e.g. https://my-resource.services.ai.azure.com/. Omit it for a key from the Anthropic API.

SetAsActive.description: Make this the project's active key for its provider when it is created or updated. Write-only.

ApiKeyMasked.description: Masked form of the API key, as shown in PostHog.

State.description: Validation state of the key: `unknown`, `ok`, `invalid` or `error`.

ErrorMessage.description: Error reported by the provider when the key last failed validation.

LastUsedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when PostHog last used the key.
